name: calculate_hash
title: Calculate Hash (registry-backed)
description: Calculates a hash or checksum over a region of the currently selected data source. Backed by ImHex's ContentRegistry::Hashes, exposing all 30+ registered algorithms (CRC32, MD5, SHA-1/224/256/384/512, Blake2, XXHash, Murmur, Adler32, all CRC variants, etc.). The data is read in a streaming fashion so this also works for very large files. Use list_hash_algorithms to discover the supported ids.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm id (e.g. 'sha256', 'md5', 'blake2b 256', 'crc32'). Accepts the short form, the full unlocalized name from list_hash_algorithms, or the prior hard-coded values for back-compat.

size.description: Number of bytes to hash. Defaults to the rest of the data source

handle.description: Handle of the data source that was hashed

algorithm.description: Algorithm that was used (the unlocalized name)

hash.description: Hex string of the hash value

address.description: Address the hash was calculated from

size.description: Number of bytes that were hashed
